name: order_block_entry_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, when institutional algorithms execute concentrated directional orders within a 15-second window (3 × 5s bars), the net 8+ spot point impulse consumes all opposing limit orders at those price levels. The last opposite-direction candle immediately before that impulse — the Order Block — contains residual unfilled resting orders from participants whose limit orders were never reached during the rush. When NIFTY retraces to this zone within 5-6 minutes, those resting limit buy/sell orders re-engage and absorb the pullback, launching a fresh directional push of 15-25 spot points. Fair Value Gaps (3-bar price discontinuities where candle i-2's extreme fails to overlap with candle i's extreme at 5-second resolution) mark levels where NIFTY's continuous auction skipped price tiers during aggressive institutional sweeps — market makers fill these gaps with directional pushes as NIFTY revisits the untraded zone, producing a short-lived but cleanly directional 15-30 spot point continuation.

indicators.name: bullish_ob_zone
indicators.formula: last bearish candle (close < open) in [i-3, i-1] when close[i] - close[i-3] >= impulse_pts. Zone = [low, high] of that candle.
indicators.purpose: 3-bar (15-second) impulse window: at 5s resolution, a significant NIFTY institutional order typically executes within 15 seconds. Using 3 bars matches the execution time of a TWAP/VWAP slice on NIFTY. The original used 3 × 1-min bars (3-min window) — we use 3 × 5s bars (15s) because we hold 15-90s, not 5-20 min. The OB bar itself is found by scanning backward within the window.

indicators.name: bearish_ob_zone
indicators.formula: last bullish candle (close > open) in [i-3, i-1] when close[i-3] - close[i] >= impulse_pts. Zone = [low, high] of that candle.
indicators.purpose: Same 15-second window logic as bullish OB, applied to bearish impulses. Zone deduplication prevents re-detecting the same OB over consecutive bars during a sustained move.

indicators.name: bullish_fvg_zone
indicators.formula: at bar i: high[i-2] < low[i] — 3-bar upward gap. Zone = [high[i-2], low[i]].
indicators.purpose: FVG detection is a 3-bar pattern with no free lookback parameter — it fires whenever a 5-second price gap exists between candle i-2's high and candle i's low. At 5s resolution, these gaps appear during rapid NIFTY bursts; they're smaller in absolute terms than 1-min FVGs but equally predictive of mean-reversion to the gap.

indicators.name: bearish_fvg_zone
indicators.formula: at bar i: low[i-2] > high[i] — 3-bar downward gap. Zone = [high[i], low[i-2]].
indicators.purpose: Symmetric downward FVG. Same detection logic as bullish FVG. Gap zones are thin (0.5-3 pts wide at 5s) so the zone touch = zone center entry, making them very precise short-term signals.

indicators.name: max_zone_age
indicators.purpose: 72 bars = 6 minutes. The original used 60 bars × 1-min (60 minutes). At 5s bars, OB/FVG zones on NIFTY lose relevance after 5-6 minutes because (1) intraday VWAP shifts, (2) new OBs overwrite old supply/demand dynamics, (3) the resting limit orders at those levels decay or are cancelled. Compressing from 60 min to 6 min is NOT 12x scaling — it's thesis-driven: NIFTY's institutional order books at any given level don't persist for hours at 5s granularity.

indicators.name: session_vwap
indicators.formula: cumulative(typical_price × volume) / cumulative(volume), reset each trading day
indicators.purpose: VWAP is a session-cumulative measure — no lookback scaling needed. Used as a directional filter: only trade bullish OB/FVG zones when NIFTY is above VWAP (institutional TWAP benchmarks favour continued buying), and only trade bearish zones when below VWAP. This aligns zone trades with intraday institutional order flow direction.

conditions: NIFTY close enters a bullish OB or bullish FVG zone (lo <= close <= hi) for the first time
Zone is no older than 72 bars (6 minutes)
NIFTY close >= session VWAP (trend aligned with demand zone)
Zone has not been previously revisited (first-touch only)
buy_ce.confirmation: Price entering zone from above (pullback into demand) — this is implicit in the OB/FVG zone definition

conditions: NIFTY close enters a bearish OB or bearish FVG zone (lo <= close <= hi) for the first time
Zone is no older than 72 bars (6 minutes)
NIFTY close <= session VWAP (trend aligned with supply zone)
Zone has not been previously revisited (first-touch only)
buy_pe.confirmation: Price entering zone from below (rally into supply) — implicit in zone definition

entry.entry_price: limit order at zone midpoint (effectively the candle close price on entry bar)

exit.stop_rationale: If NIFTY closes 4 option pts (≈8 spot pts at ATM delta ~0.5) against the trade, the OB/FVG zone has been fully consumed by opposing flow and the residual resting orders thesis is invalidated. NIFTY's typical 30-second adverse move against a valid zone touch is 2-5 pts; a 4-pt stop provides room for the 1-bar noise (1-3 pts at 5s) while cutting quickly if the zone fails.
exit.target_rationale: OB/FVG re-activation on NIFTY typically produces 15-25 spot point continuation in 15-60 seconds. At ATM delta ~0.5, capturing 55-60% of that move = 7-12 option pts. 7 pts targets the conservative end (15 spot pts × 0.5 delta × 93% = ~7 pts), achieving 1:1.75 R:R against the 4-pt stop — profitable at 55%+ win rate.

filters.vix_filter: none — VIX data not used; NIFTY OB/FVG zones work across volatility regimes
filters.time_filter: 09:25-15:20 IST; skip first 10 minutes (pre-open zones from 09:15-09:25 have no VWAP context)
filters.volume_filter: none — impulse detection already filters for meaningful moves (>= impulse_pts); volume is noisy at 5s resolution
filters.trend_filter: VWAP alignment: bullish zones only when close >= VWAP, bearish zones only when close <= VWAP
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution, no bid-ask cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: Medium — ICT methodology is growing on Indian trading communities (YouTube, Telegram). As more retail traders place limit orders at OB zones, the zones become self-defeating. However, institutional OB/FVG formation at 5-second resolution is driven by algo execution mechanics that are more structural than retail behavior.

adaptation_notes: The original used 1-min bars on NIFTY50 constituent stocks + NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index with 5-20 minute holds. Key adaptations: (1) OB impulse window compressed from 3×1-min (3-min impulse) to 3×5s (15s impulse) — we capture micro-institutional sweeps rather than full directional flows; (2) Zone age limit compressed from 60 bars × 1min (60 min) to 72 bars × 5s (6 min) — thesis-driven, not 12x scaled, because 5s-scale OB zones lose institutional support much faster; (3) FVG detection is conceptually unchanged but fires at 5s frequency producing smaller gaps (0.5-3 pts wide vs 5-15 pts on 1-min); (4) Direction filter changed from VWAP trend (same concept, same implementation) but now inline rather than a separate indicator; (5) Stops/targets changed from percentage-based (2 bps stop, impulse-high target) to absolute option premium points calibrated to 15-90s NIFTY move magnitudes; (6) Universe narrowed to NIFTY index only (not individual stocks), which is actually the PRIMARY thesis vehicle mentioned in the original.
weaknesses: OB/FVG zones at 5-second resolution are very narrow (0.5-3 spot pts wide) — first-touch detection requires extremely precise price levels that may fire on noise rather than genuine zone tests.
Circular buffer of 80 zones may overflow on high-volatility days producing many FVGs; oldest zones overwritten, potentially missing important zones created earlier in session.

The 'first touch only' rule creates adverse selection: if a zone fires false on noise, the zone is consumed and will not re-fire even if the institutional order level is real and later produces the expected bounce.

NIFTY at 5s resolution has low intraday autocorrelation in short windows; OB/FVG thesis assumes resting orders persist for 1-6 minutes, which may not hold if SEBI regulations or algo risk limits cause rapid order cancellation.

_source.original_stop: 2 bps beyond far edge of OB/FVG zone
_source.original_target: re-test of impulse move high/low that created the zone
